sections.title: Day 3 學習概覽
sections.markdown: 今天進入 **詞性辨識強化日**。前兩天已完成五大句型與基本詞性概念，因此今天提高一點難度，主攻 **Part 5 詞性陷阱、Part 2 間接回答、Part 7 快速定位**。目前沒有收到前兩天的小考作答紀錄，所以暫時維持「860+ 標準難度」。今天建議約 **90～110 分鐘**。

sections.title: ① 今日高頻單字 30 個
sections.markdown:
主題是 **Sales / Marketing / Customer Service**。

|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | customer | 顧客 | customer service |
| 2 | client | 客戶 | potential client |
| 3 | consumer | 消費者 | consumer demand |
| 4 | advertise | 廣告 | advertise a product |
| 5 | advertisement | 廣告 | place an advertisement |
| 6 | promotion | 促銷 | sales promotion |
| 7 | promotional | 促銷的 | promotional campaign |
| 8 | campaign | 活動；宣傳 | advertising campaign |
| 9 | launch | 推出 | launch a product |

| 11 | distribution | 配送；分布 | distribution center |
| 12 | demand | 需求 | meet demand |
| 13 | increase | 增加 | increase sales |
| 14 | decline | 下降 | sales declined |

| 16 | profit | 利潤 | increase profits |

| 25 | response | 回應 | prompt response |

優先掌握：**customer satisfaction / request a refund / respond to an inquiry / conduct a survey / launch a product / meet demand / competitive price**。特別注意 respond **to** an inquiry，不是 respond an inquiry。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜N / V / Adj / Adv 秒判
sections.markdown:
金色證書程度的 Part 5 很常故意把同一字根放在四個選項。

> The new advertising campaign was extremely _____.

(A) success (B) succeed (C) successful (D) successfully

extremely 是副詞，副詞後面常修飾形容詞，因此是 extremely **successful**，答案 C。

| 詞性 | 單字 |
|---|---|
| N | success |
| V | succeed |
| Adj | successful |
| Adv | successfully |

### 快速判斷

a / an / the + 空格：優先考慮名詞。空格 + noun：優先考慮形容詞。verb + 空格：可能是受詞名詞。空格 + adjective：通常是副詞。be + 空格：常見形容詞，但也可能是進行式，因此仍需看句子結構。

sections.title: ③ Part 5 詞性陷阱
sections.markdown:
### Example 1

> Customer _____ is one of the company's highest priorities.

Customer _____ 是主詞，需要名詞，答案 **satisfaction**。

### Example 2

> Customers were _____ with the new service.

were _____ 描述 customers 的狀態，答案 **satisfied**。

### Example 3

> The issue was resolved _____.

resolved 是動詞，修飾動詞需要副詞 **satisfactorily**。請把 satisfaction → satisfied → satisfactorily 當成同一字族學習。

sections.title: ④ Listening｜Part 2 間接回答
sections.markdown:
### Q1

> Where is the sales meeting being held?

(A) I think Daniel reserved Room 204. (B) About twenty employees. (C) For two hours.

答案 **A**。沒有直接說 In Room 204，而要從 Daniel reserved Room 204 推論。

### Q2

> When will the new printer arrive?

(A) The old one is broken. (B) The supplier hasn't confirmed the date yet. (C) Near the reception desk.

答案 **B**。When 不一定出現日期。

### Q3

> Who's going to contact the client?

答案：**Didn't Sarah say she would?**

### Q4

> Why don't we postpone the meeting?

答案：**That's probably a good idea.** Why don't we... 是提出建議。

### Q5

> Could you send me the updated schedule?

答案：**Sure, I'll email it to you.** Could you... 是請求，不是能力問題。

sections.title: ⑤ Reading｜Part 7 定位訓練
sections.markdown:
> **From:** Customer Service
> **To:** Daniel Lin
> **Subject:** Your Recent Purchase
> Dear Mr. Lin,
> Thank you for contacting us regarding the wireless headphones you purchased from our online store last week.
> We are sorry to hear that the product is not functioning properly. We can either send you a replacement at no additional cost or provide a full refund.
> If you would like a replacement, please reply to this email before September 8 and confirm your shipping address. Replacement products normally arrive within three to five business days.
> Thank you for your patience.
> Customer Service Department

Q1 為何聯絡公司？答案 **B：產品無法正常運作**。Q2 公司提供什麼？答案 **C：replacement or refund**。Q3 收到 replacement 前要做什麼？答案 **C：提供 shipping address**。Q4 replacement 最接近哪個字？答案 **A：substitute**。字義題要利用「產品壞掉，公司再寄一個」的上下文。

sections.title: ⑥ TOEIC 仿真題｜8 題
sections.markdown: 請到「階段小考」完成 8 題 Part 5 仿真題。重點是同字根詞性、固定搭配與修飾關係。

sections.title: ⑦ 今日 10 題小考
sections.markdown: 這組比 Day 2 稍微難一些。請到「階段小考」選擇 Day 3 小考作答。

sections.title: ⑧ 答案與解析
sections.markdown:
仿真題答案：**1 A / 2 C / 3 C / 4 B / 5 A / 6 B / 7 C / 8 A**。

重要結構：work more **efficiently**（修飾 work）、several **favorable** comments（修飾 comments）、responded **promptly**（修飾 responded）。

今日小考：**1 A / 2 C / 3 C / 4 B / 5 A / 6 A / 7 B / 8 B / 9 A / 10 C**。Q2 中空格修飾 positive，因此是 **overwhelmingly positive**。Q6 The supplier hasn't told me yet. 是 When 問句的間接回答。Why don't we conduct an online survey? 是提出建議，因此可答 That's worth trying。

sections.title: ⑨ Day 1～2 錯題複習
sections.markdown:
| Verb | Noun | Adjective | Adverb |
|---|---|---|---|
| succeed | success | successful | successfully |
| qualify | qualification | qualified | — |
| approve | approval | approved | — |
| satisfy | satisfaction | satisfied | satisfactorily |
| respond | response | responsive | responsively |

看到四個選項同字根時，不要先翻譯。順序改成：**① 找空格位置 → ② 判斷詞性 → ③ 排除 → ④ 最後確認意思。**

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業與進度判斷
sections.markdown:
先把 30 個單字快速複習兩輪，再將 Day 1～3 累積的 90 個單字做第一次總複習，優先記搭配。朗讀五句各 3 次：The company launched a new product. / Customer satisfaction has improved significantly. / Please respond to the inquiry promptly. / The company offered a full refund. / We conducted an online survey.

睡前在 5 分鐘內重做 10 題小考，目標 **10/10 + 平均每題 30 秒以內**。9～10 題正確可在 Day 4 提升難度；7～8 題維持難度；5～6 題增加基礎複習；0～4 題先降低速度。核心反射是：**看到空格 → 看結構 → 判斷詞性 → 最後才看意思。**

questions.prompt: The marketing department plans to _____ a new advertising campaign next month.
questions.explanation: plan to 後使用原形動詞 launch。

questions.prompt: Customer _____ has improved significantly since the company introduced its new return policy.
questions.explanation: Customer satisfaction 是名詞片語並作主詞。

questions.prompt: The new software allows employees to work more _____.
questions.explanation: 副詞 efficiently 修飾動詞 work。

questions.prompt: The company received several _____ comments about its new product.
questions.explanation: 形容詞 favorable 修飾 comments。

questions.prompt: Customers requesting a _____ must provide the original receipt.
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a 後需要名詞 refund。

questions.prompt: The company responded _____ to customer complaints.
questions.explanation: 副詞 promptly 修飾 responded。

questions.prompt: The advertising campaign successfully _____ thousands of new customers.
questions.explanation: 句子需要過去式動詞 attracted。

questions.prompt: The manufacturer provides a two-year _____ on all electronic products.
questions.explanation: a two-year 後需要名詞 warranty。

questions.prompt: The company hopes to _____ its sales in overseas markets.
questions.explanation: hope to 後使用原形動詞 increase。

questions.prompt: The hotel has received _____ positive feedback from its guests.
questions.explanation: 副詞 overwhelmingly 修飾形容詞 positive。

questions.prompt: Our customer service representatives respond to inquiries very _____.
questions.explanation: 副詞 promptly 修飾 respond。

questions.prompt: The company's latest product has been commercially _____.
questions.explanation: be 動詞後使用形容詞 successful。

questions.prompt: Customers are encouraged to provide _____ about their shopping experience.
When will the replacement printer arrive?

options.A: The supplier hasn't told me yet.

questions.explanation: 尚未收到日期是合理的間接回答。

questions.prompt: Who's responsible for the advertising campaign?
Why don't we conduct an online survey?
questions.explanation: Why don't we... 是提出建議。

questions.prompt: Could you respond to this customer inquiry?
Where should I put these promotional materials?

options.C: There's some space near the entrance.

keyTakeaway: 看到空格 → 看結構 → 判斷詞性 → 最後才看意思。
nextDay: 現在式／現在進行式／過去式／現在完成式 + 時間訊號
